claims: Sony reports that most PlayStation Network (PSN) services have been restored as of March 22, 2026.
The restoration followed a widespread, global outage that occurred on Saturday evening.
Sony's Status Page shows most, if not all, services are "up and running".
Sony's Status Page previously indicated a "partial outage".
The outage significantly impacted user logins.
The outage significantly impacted game launching.
At the peak of the outage, Downdetector logged over 14,000 complaints.
Major issues were reported in server connection.
Major issues were reported in login
